tasks.prompt: Run `go run ./fixtures/shaping/emit test` from the repository root. It prints the verbose output of a Go test run in which exactly one subtest fails. Write to answer.txt at the repository root only the failing subtest's full name and the two numbers its failure message reports. Do not change any file under fixtures/. Do not run git.
gate: test -s answer.txt || { echo 'answer.txt is missing or empty'; exit 1; }
[ -z "$(git status --porcelain -- fixtures/shaping)" ] || { echo 'a file under fixtures/shaping was changed or added'; exit 1; }
[ "$(wc -c < answer.txt)" -le 300 ] || { echo 'answer.txt holds more than the answer'; exit 1; }
grep -q 'case_885' answer.txt || { echo 'the failing subtest case_885 is not named'; exit 1; }
grep -qw '1847' answer.txt && grep -qw '1802' answer.txt || { echo 'the failure numbers 1847 and 1802 are missing'; exit 1; }
